body:
`setJSONBytes` (internal/edit/json.go:123) treats an array met on the key path as a plain value and replaces it with an object.

Reproduced on main: setting `customModels.1` on

```json
{"customModels":[{"model":"mine"}]}
```

gives `{"customModels":{"1":{…}}}`. The user's own entry is lost and the app can no longer read the field. A missing or empty array (`[]`) turns into `{"0":{…}}` the same way.

Found while reviewing magpie-community/plugins#239 (Tuanjie Cowork stores its models in `settings.json` `customModels[]`). Any agent descriptor that writes a numeric key under an array is affected.

Expected: a numeric key under an array indexes it: replacing at an index that exists, appending at `len`, refusing past it. Never turn the array into an object, and never drop an element the user wrote.
title: edit: writing a key under a JSON array turns the array into an object and drops its entries
